passive.name: Sap Magic
passive.text: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.

spells.name: Bramble Smash
spells.text: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.

spells.name: Twisted Advance
spells.text: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.

spells.name: Sapling Toss
spells.text: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard. More effective in brush.

spells.name: Nature's Grasp
spells.text: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.

archetype.value: Maokai is a crowd-control engager who dashes to root a target and knocks back nearby enemies.

winCondition.value: Maokai wins by controlling enemies with knockbacks, slows, and roots.

spikes.at: When Bramble Smash reaches its 5-second cooldown
spikes.why: Maokai can knock back and slow enemies more often.

bait.why: Maokai cannot use Twisted Advance’s untargetable dash and root again until its cooldown ends.
